The '''Lost King of Duro''' was a [[Duros]]<ref name="sw100" /> [[Gender|male]] [[king]] of [[Duro]] whose [[Mummy|mummified]] [[Limb|hand]] was displayed in [[Dryden Vos]]' [[Dryden's study|study]] onboard his [[yacht]], the ''[[First Light]]''<ref name="TOG" /> in [[10 BBY]].<ref name="sw100" /> On each of the fingers of the hand were ring lockets that held preserved cell samples of the royal bloodline.<ref name="TOG" />
